mapper.select: SELECT requirement_id AS requirementId, policy_id AS policyId, requirement_no AS requirementNo, scanner_code AS scannerCode, scan_type AS scanType, minimum_scanner_version AS minimumScannerVersion, accepted_result_codes AS acceptedResultCodes, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_file_scan_requirement WHERE policy_id IN #{id} ORDER BY policy_id, requirement_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_file_scan_requirement (requirement_id, policy_id, requirement_no, scanner_code, scan_type, minimum_scanner_version, accepted_result_codes, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.requirementId}, #{row.policyId}, #{row.requirementNo}, #{row.scannerCode}, #{row.scanType}, #{row.minimumScannerVersion}, #{row.acceptedResultCodes}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
